inspection.archiveBytes: Length in bytes of the downloaded original ZIP container, including its ZIP metadata; not expanded payload bytes.
inspection.regularOuterFiles: Count non-directory entries at the ZIP root: manifest.json plus four package tarballs. Directory entries are excluded.
inspection.reproduce: Download archiveUrl without repacking, measure the downloaded file length, and list its non-directory root ZIP entries. These are inspection-summary fields, not fields of the canonical schema-2 package manifest.

scope: Public artifact identity snapshot; not a cryptographic verification result or a host-acceptance receipt.
